job.name: ig11_host_a
job.meaning: мужчина ~55, седеющие волосы назад, крупные очки в тёмной оправе, тёмный жаккардовый пиджак-бомбер с узором, серая футболка, стол, микрофон на штанге, тёплая студия
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a stylish charismatic Russian man about 55, greying swept-back hair, bold thick dark-rimmed glasses, a dark patterned jacquard jacket over a grey t-shirt. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, waist-up, both shoulders inside the frame, centred, sitting at a round light-beige table with forearms resting on it, a professional podcast microphone on a white boom arm entering from the left side in front of his chest (not covering the face), top of head about 14% below the upper edge, face large and sharp, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, warm knowing half-smile, NO broad smile. Background: a warm luxurious studio — beige draped curtains, soft golden table lamps with pleated shades, warm bokeh. Look: a real frame from a high-end podcast camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
